correctness.rationale: Monotonicity plus back yields f[up x]=up f(x); root proves image cone. For maps T_H onto T_K fixing root, child images either include target root, yielding (A+B)^d-B^d, or omit root, forcing a permutation of d immediate children and d!*R(H-1,K-1)^d. Idempotence fixes the cone and spine, while off-spine child subtrees contribute independent S_d counts. Standard finite Stone/modal duality yields inverse-image maps with algebraic image size 2^rank. Independently evaluated all 823543 functions on binary height-two seven-world frame and obtained E coefficients 4,28,8 and I 4,8,1; also checked smaller trees.
